# Third-party assets (Treatment lab, Addendum 4)

All assets below are CC0 1.0 (public domain). They were downloaded with curl on 2026-11-19; only the maps the project uses
(colour, OpenGL normal, ambient occlusion, HDRI) are kept, at 1K (textures) and 2K (HDRI).

| Asset | Folder | Source | License | Author |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Metal012 (brushed metal) | ambientCG/Metal012 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Metal012 (download https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Metal012_1K-JPG.zip) | CC0 1.0 | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) |
| Terrazzo013 (terrazzo floor) | ambientCG/Terrazzo013 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Terrazzo013 (download https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Terrazzo013_1K-JPG.zip) | CC0 1.0 | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) |
| Ground015 (soil) | ambientCG/Ground015 | https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Ground015 (download https://ambientcg.com/get?file=Ground015_1K-JPG.zip) | CC0 1.0 | ambientCG (Lennart Demes) |
| Coated Pine (timber ceiling) | PolyHaven/coated_pine | https://polyhaven.com/a/coated_pine | CC0 1.0 | Charlotte Baglioni (scanning), Rico Cilliers (processing) |
| Aloe Farm Shade House HDRI (lighting and reflections) | PolyHaven/aloe_farm_shade_house | https://polyhaven.com/a/aloe_farm_shade_house (https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/2k/aloe_farm_shade_house_2k.hdr) | CC0 1.0 | Dimitrios Savva (photography), Jarod Guest (processing) |

## Substitutions (not downloaded)
- The paid Laboratory Multipurpose Pack and Laboratory Equipment vol. 1 are not available. The lab furniture is built from the
  project's own room code with the materials above.
- Sprayer: the project's own `Assets/Lab_Treatment_Assets/spray-bottle/model/SprayBottle_Quest.fbx` with a matte material.
- Gloves: the XR Hands package sample hand models (`Assets/Samples/XR Hands/1.8.0/HandVisualizer/Models/RightHand.fbx`, Unity
  Companion License) with a blue nitrile material.
- Wheat outside the windows: no CC0 wheat-field patch with LODs was used; the existing vineyard/Farm scenery stays.
